items.title: Tasmania's police minister apologises for naming Port Arthur gunman
items.description: Felix Ellis has apologised for comments he made during budget estimates about the 1996 Port Arthur massacre in which he named the gunman, with one survivor labelling his comments "hurtful" and "disrespectful".

items.title: Trump battles historians for ownership of US presidential records
items.description: The Trump administration is pushing for a return to pre-Nixon days when US presidents could do whatever they wanted with presidential records.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' political movement spills onto Delhi's streets
items.description: India's largest online youth movement has taken to the streets for the first time, calling for the resignation of the education minister.

items.title: Struggling and desperate single mum saved by an 'employment mentor'
items.description: Personalised support helped domestic violence survivor and single mother Harsimran get a job, despite significant barriers. It's an approach that could benefit more jobseekers following the federal government's revamp of Workforce Australia.

items.title: 'Rain bomb', mini tornadoes: Debunking Australia's greatest weather myths
items.description: Meteorologic rhetoric in Australia, including from the media, can at times be inaccurate, misconstrued or just completely fictitious.

items.title: How looksmaxxing trend is affecting young men
items.description: While it's a bit of fun for some, the social media trend known as looksmaxxing can have major impacts on young men's physical and mental health.

items.title: Will Australia be taken for a ride in the AI and data centre boom?
items.description: More than $150 billion is lined up for data centre development and investment in Australia, but there are questions as to whether the boom will provide benefits beyond a short-term construction boost.

items.title: As vaccination rates fall in Australia, a grieving British mother has a warning
items.description: Measles killed Rebecca Archer's daughter Renae slowly and silently over a decade. She has a message for the growing number of parents hesitant to have their children vaccinated.

items.title: Live: Yengi draws Socceroos level in terrific response after half-time
items.description: Tony Popovic's half-time subs pay dividends as Tete Yengi draws the Socceroos level with Switzerland with a debut goal. Follow live.

items.title: Diver dies after being bitten by 4.5m shark off Albany, WA
items.description: A male diver has died after an attack by a suspected 4.5-metre shark near Michaelmas Island, off WA's Albany coast, on Saturday morning.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
